info.title: WOODEX OS: the API for the shop and outside clients
info.description:
The contract of /api/v1, address by address and key by key. The rules it follows, and why, are docs/woodex-os/29-API-V1-RULES.md.

Every answer is JSON in one of three shapes: {data, meta}, {data, meta, links} for a page of a list, or {error, meta}. A picture is the one exception: its bytes. No address needs a sign-in, none sets a cookie, and none is for staff.

An address this document does not name answers 404 (NOT_FOUND); an address it names, asked with another method, answers 405 (METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED) with an Allow header, unless its part is switched off, which answers 404.

platform/tests/Feature/Api/V1ContractTest.php holds the application to this document.

post.summary: An enquiry from a visitor of the shop
post.description:
Makes an enquiry, or adds to the open enquiry the same visitor already has (found by telephone number or e-mail, within 30 days). With consent and "whatsapp" as the preferred channel the answer carries a hand-off.

Switch: the module lead_api (on as the product ships). Limit: 5 a minute and 50 a day from one address, shared with the older enquiry address.

200.description: The visitor already had an open enquiry: this one was added to it.

202.description: Taken for a robot's. It looks accepted and nothing was kept: reference is null.

post.summary: The visitor chose WhatsApp: write it down and give the link
post.description:
Writes on the enquiry's timeline that a WhatsApp chat was prepared, and answers the link that opens it. Nothing is sent to anybody. The token is this request's key: sent twice it is written down once and answered the same, until it expires. An unknown token, an expired one and one of a deleted enquiry are answered alike (404).

Switch: the module lead_api. Limit: 20 a minute from one address.

post.summary: The basket of a visitor, saved for the team to review
post.description:
Prices the basket from the catalogue and saves it with an enquiry. It is not a quotation. A product that is not offered for this refuses the whole request (422), naming the line.

Switches: the modules lead_api and quote_requests (the second is off as the product ships). Limit: as for an enquiry.

202.description: Taken for a robot's. It looks accepted and nothing was kept: reference and status are null.

get.summary: The category tree with its published pages, and the series
get.description:
One document, always whole: the shop builds its menu from it. A category shows its page only once the page is published.

Switch: CATEGORY_SYNC_ENABLED (on unless set otherwise); off, it answers 503. Limit: 120 a minute from one address.

get.summary: The picture of a published category page
get.description: Only the picture of the version that is published now, of a category that is switched on. Limit: 120 a minute from one address.

parameters.name: revision
parameters.description: The published version of its page.

get.summary: The photographs of the shop that were replaced in the admin
get.description: Each entry says: where the shop shows this file of its own, show that one instead. Only replacements that were published; never the library. Always the whole list. Limit: 120 a minute from one address.
The address is the one the list gave. A replacement that was withdrawn is gone (404). Limit: 120 a minute from one address.

The products the admin has published, newest change first. A draft, a withdrawn product and an archived one are never handed out: to the shop all three are absent, and so is a product whose publication was withdrawn while its draft still exists.

Paged: 24 to a page unless per_page says otherwise, 100 at most. `since` is how the shop collects a change without reading the whole list again: it keeps the highest `updated_at` it has seen and asks for what changed after it.

`position` counts on across the pages, so a client that asks for page two receives 25, 26, 27… Money is whole paisa; a product without a price is on_request and carries no figure.

Switch: PRODUCT_SYNC_ENABLED (on unless set otherwise); off, it answers 503. Limit: 120 a minute from one address.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: How many products a page holds; 24 when not said, 100 at most.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Only the products published in this category or in any category below it, by its slug.

parameters.name: series
parameters.description: Only the products published in this series, by its slug.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only the products saved at or after this moment, written as every moment of this API is.

200.description: One page of the published products.

get.summary: One published product, by the address the shop knows it by
get.description:
The same product the list hands out, alone. A product that was never published, one whose publication was withdrawn and one that is archived answer exactly as an address nothing is at (404): a different answer would tell a visitor which drafts exist.

Switch: PRODUCT_SYNC_ENABLED; off, it answers 503. Limit: 120 a minute from one address.

get.summary: One photograph of a published product
get.description:
The bytes of a photograph the published copy of a product carries. Only a photograph of that publication: not a picture of a draft, not one of another product, and not an older version of one.

Limit: 120 a minute from one address.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: The number of the picture in the admin.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: The published revision it belongs to, as the product’s `pictures` name it.

RequestNumber.description: The number of this request. The same number is in the X-Request-Id header and on every line the request left in the log.

total.description: How many entries the list has. The list is always whole.

PageMeta.description: The meta of one page of a list. No address answers in pages yet; the first will be the products.

total.description: How many records the whole list has.

self.description: This page, as an address on this site without its name.

ErrorCode.description: What went wrong, for a program. A closed list: a client may decide by it.

Error.description: Every error under /api/v1, whatever went wrong.

message.description: What went wrong, for a person, in English. It may be reworded; decide by the code.

details.description: By name: the messages of each refused field (VALIDATION_FAILED), or the parameters that were refused and those that are allowed (PARAMETER_NOT_ALLOWED). Empty otherwise.

token.description: Good for one visitor and for fifteen minutes. Send it to /leads/whatsapp-handoff in the body, never in an address.

reference.description: The reference of the enquiry, to show to the visitor. Null when nothing was kept (202).

delivery.description: Always this: the link was prepared, and nothing was sent to anybody.

whatsapp_url.description: Opens the chat with the business, with the enquiry's reference written in.

reference.description: The reference of the request. Null when nothing was kept (202).

status.description: "pending_review": saved for the team to look at. It is not a quotation, an order or a reservation.

CategoryPageContent.description: A published category page. These keys and no others.

hero_url.description: The address of the page's picture on this site, without its name.

top_html.description: HTML made here from what the editor chose; safe to put into the page as it is.

featured_ids.description: The shop's own keys of the products to show, in order.

parent_id.description: The category above this one; null at the top.

position.description: Its place among the categories with the same parent, lowest first.

categories.description: Every category that is switched on and whose parents are, parents before children.

key.description: A file of the shop's own bundle.

url.description: The address of its replacement on this site, without its name.

EnquiryBody.description: An enquiry. A field that is not named here is ignored.

phone.description: A telephone number. One of phone and email is required.

email.description: An e-mail address. One of phone and email is required.

preferred_channel.description: How the visitor wants to be answered. With "whatsapp" and consent, the answer carries a hand-off.

consent.description: The visitor agreed to be contacted.

service.description: What the enquiry is about, in the shop's own word.

business_line.description: Only "furniture" is taken here; it is also the default.

turnstile_token.description: The token of the robot check, where the site uses one. Not part of what makes two requests the same.

form_started_at.description: When the form was opened, in seconds or milliseconds since 1970. Not part of what makes two requests the same.

BasketBody.description: A basket with the visitor's details. Consent must be given. Nothing the page says about a price, a total or a name of a product is read.

phone.description: A telephone number. One of phone and email is required.

email.description: An e-mail address. One of phone and email is required.

preferred_channel.description: How the visitor wants to be answered. With "whatsapp" and consent, the answer carries a hand-off.

consent.description: The visitor agreed to be contacted.

service.description: What the enquiry is about, in the shop's own word.

business_line.description: Only "furniture" is taken here; it is also the default.

turnstile_token.description: The token of the robot check, where the site uses one. Not part of what makes two requests the same.

form_started_at.description: When the form was opened, in seconds or milliseconds since 1970. Not part of what makes two requests the same.

items.description: The basket: 1 to 50 lines, each product once.

BasketLine.description: One line. A colour or an option cannot be asked for here yet: a line that names one is refused.

product_id.description: The shop's own key of the product.

HandoffBody.description: The token an enquiry was answered with.

Product.description: One product as the admin published it. Only the published copy is ever handed out: a draft saved after publication, a withdrawn product and an archived one are all absent. Money is whole paisa in a key ending in _minor, with the currency beside it; a product published without a price is on_request and its price_minor is null, never 0.

id.description: The address the shop knows the product by: its slug.

sku.description: The product's own code, when it is sold in one form; null when it has none, or when it is sold in options, each of which then has a code of its own.

category_ids.description: Every category the product is published in.

primary_category_id.description: The category it is listed under first; null when it has none.

availability.description: What the editor said about ordering it: available, unavailable, or on_request, which means that it is made to order and its availability is confirmed when somebody asks. It says nothing about the price: on_request below does.

price_minor.description: What it costs now, in paisa: the sale price while a sale is on, the regular price at every other time. null when on_request is true: a product published without a price carries no figure, never 0.

was_price_minor.description: The regular price, while a sale is on; null at every other time.

on_request.description: The editor published it as "Price on request": it has no price. The shop may show it and take a quotation request for it, and must not print a buying price or put it in a cart. price_minor is null exactly when this is true.

variants.description: The ways it is sold: a size, a finish. A product with any is ordered by one of them. The one row that carries the code of a product sold in one form is not among them: it is the product's sku.

related_ids.description: The products the editor chose to show beside it; empty unless related_mode is manual.

pictures.description: Its photographs, in the order its editor put them, each at an address of its own.

position.description: Its place in the whole list, counted from 1 across the pages: page two of 24 begins at 25.

revision.description: The number of the published revision this answer was made from.

updated_at.description: When the product was last saved, published or not. A client asks for what changed after it.

price_minor.description: What this option costs now, in paisa: its own price (its own sale price while that sale is on), or the product's price when the option has none of its own. null when the product is priced on request.

url.description: The address of the picture on this site, without its name.

alt.description: What the picture shows, in the words its editor wrote for somebody who cannot see it. Never the product name unless that is what was written.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: A new UUID for each thing you create. Send the same request again with the same key and it is written once and answered the same; a key that was used for other content is refused (409).

RequestId.description: The number of this request, the same as meta.request_id.

IdempotentReplayed.description: "true" when this create was answered from its first sending and nothing was written now. Absent otherwise.

BadRequest.description: The request cannot be read as it is: a query parameter this address does not take (PARAMETER_NOT_ALLOWED), a body that is not a JSON object (BAD_REQUEST), or a create without a UUID in its Idempotency-Key header (IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED).

NotFound.description: NOT_FOUND: nothing is at this address, the record is not there, or this part is switched off on this site.

Conflict.description: IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: the key was used before for a request with other content. Or CONFLICT: somebody else was saving the same records in that moment and nothing was saved; send the request again with the same key.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE: the body is not sent as JSON.

ValidationFailed.description: VALIDATION_FAILED: a field was refused. details names each refused field with its messages.

ServerError.description: SERVER_ERROR: a fault on this side. The answer says nothing about it but the number of the request.

Unavailable.description: UNAVAILABLE: this is switched off or not set up at the moment. Ask again later.
